ref_text: IT TAKES ME SEVERAL YEARS TO MAKE THIS MAGIC POWDER BUT AT THIS MOMENT I AM PLEASED TO SAY IT IS NEARLY DONE YOU SEE I AM MAKING IT FOR MY GOOD WIFE MARGOLOTTE WHO WANTS TO USE SOME OF IT FOR A PURPOSE OF HER OWN
text: It takes me several years to make this magic powder, but at this moment I am pleased to say it is nearly done. You see I am making it for my good wife Margot Lot, who wants to use some of it for a purpose of her own.
